about: V0 test-phase frontend bug: a failed Load more wiped every loaded post and showed only an error. setup.patch puts the old isError check back in PostList.
prompt: Bug report: on Home, if Load more fails, every post already on screen disappears and only an error is shown. The posts should stay, with the error and a retry beside Load more. The Playwright test 'a failed Load more keeps the posts, shows an error and can be tried again' in frontend/e2e/feed.spec.ts fails. Fix it.
